summary_en: 456,302 treasury shares (3.21% of outstanding shares) will be cancelled effective November 26, 2026, contingent on shareholder approval of a planned stock split on November 27, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 6, 2026, Satudora Holdings' board of directors resolved to cancel 456,302 treasury shares held by the company, representing 3.21% of outstanding shares as of September 24, 2026. The cancellation is scheduled to become effective on November 26, 2026. Following this cancellation, the total number of outstanding shares will be 13,780,262.

The cancellation is conditional upon shareholder approval of a planned stock split (1-for-5 consolidation) with an effective date of November 27, 2026, which will be voted on at an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for November 6, 2026. The treasury shares to be cancelled represent all treasury stock held by the company as of September 24, 2026.
